commands: ls -R . | grep -v pyc | head -50 && cat rosterkit/__init__.py && ls tests; sed -n 1,40p rosterkit/models.py; head -30 tests/*.py | head -60
cat rosterkit/errors.py docs/conventions.txt Makefile; head -20 rosterkit/summary.py; tail -15 CHANGES.txt

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='rosterkit/seating.py'
s=open(p).read().replace("sorted(\n        students, key=_sort_key\n    )","sorted(students, key=_sort_key)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
sed -i 's/^## Unreleased$/&\n- Add seating_rows to lay students out in rows by last name./' CHANGES.txt
awk 'length>60' rosterkit/seating.py; wc -l rosterkit/seating.py; make check 2>&1 | tail -3
git add -A && git commit -q -m "Add seating module for row layouts" -m "Teachers need a quick way to turn a roster into seating rows. This adds seating_rows, which sorts by last name and rejects empty input or a non-positive row size." -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -1

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='rosterkit/seating.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"""One text line per row, students sorted by last name."""','"""One line per row, sorted by last name."""')
s=s.replace("    return (student.last_name.lower(), student.first_name.lower())","    last = student.last_name.lower()\n    return (last, student.first_name.lower())")
open(p,'w').write(s)
c=open('CHANGES.txt').read().replace("## Unreleased\n","## Unreleased\n- Add seating_rows to lay out students by last name.\n",1)
open('CHANGES.txt','w').write(c)
EOF
awk 'length>60' rosterkit/seating.py tests/test_seating.py; make check 2>&1 | tail -2

commits.subject: Add seating module for row layouts
commits.message:
Add seating module for row layouts

Teachers need a quick way to turn a roster into seating rows. This adds seating_rows, which sorts by last name and rejects empty input or a non-positive row size.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
